info.description: Subscription tiers, checkout (SePay Payment Gateway or the dev fake), the SePay IPN webhook, the viewer's subscriptions and payments, Studio monetization (tiers, overview, ledger, payouts) and the admin payout queue. Get a token from identity-svc (http://localhost:8090/swagger/index.html → /auth/login; admin@nexuslive.dev for /admin) and paste "Bearer <accessToken>" into Authorize.
info.title: NexusLive billing-svc API

get.description: Newest first. needsReview=true lists paid orders that could not be applied (another tier was live); status CSV; q = invoice number prefix (case-insensitive).
status REQUESTED (default, oldest first), APPROVED, REJECTED or ALL (newest first); each row carries the channel balance.

post.description: REQUESTED → APPROVED with a PAYOUT debit in the ledger (no money is moved). A reviewed payout → 409.

get.description: Decrypted on demand; every view is written to the audit log (PAYOUT_BANK_INFO_VIEWED). Not cached.
get.summary: The full bank account of a payout

post.description: reason 10–500 characters after trim; the amount is available again. A reviewed payout → 409.

get.description: Active tiers by level (AC-H01). Unknown channel → 404, suspended channel → 403.
Payment methods offered on the modal (BILLING_SEPAY_METHODS) and the fixed rules.

post.description: Creates a PENDING order (30 min) and the signed form to post to the payment page, fields in order. The caller's pending order of the same tier is returned with 200 (re-signed). Requires Idempotency-Key (UUID): same key and body → the stored answer with Idempotent-Replay: true; same key, other body → 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED; still running → 409 CONFLICT. 409 INVALID_STATE details.reason: TIER_INACTIVE, TIER_CHANGE (currentTier, currentPeriodEnd), MAX_PREPAID (currentPeriodEnd, maxPeriodEnd), ORDER_PENDING (orderId, tierLevel). 409 CONFLICT details.limit = 5 pending orders.

200.description: pending order of the same tier

get.description: With the subscription it created; an order in review shows the caller's current subscription of the channel. Another user's order → 404.
get.summary: A checkout order of the caller

post.description: Only PENDING orders (else 409). The payment provider is told best effort; money that still arrives wins (the order becomes PAID).

Called by /checkout/result. Paid at the provider → PAID; outcome CANCEL → CANCELLED; ERROR → FAILED (reason from the lookup); SUCCESS and not paid yet → stays PENDING (poll GET). The redirect alone never marks an order paid. At most 10 calls a minute per order (429 details.retryAfterSec).
post.summary: Check a pending order with the payment provider

get.description: The channel and its active tiers; the requested tier is included even when inactive.
Checkout orders, newest first; status is an optional CSV of PENDING, PAID, CANCELLED, FAILED, EXPIRED, VOIDED.

status=current (default, by period end ascending) or expired (newest first). With channelId and no status: at most one row — the current subscription of that channel, else the most recently ended one (Subscribe button state).

post.description: ACTIVE → CANCELLED_PENDING_END; benefits stay until currentPeriodEnd. Requires Idempotency-Key. A second cancel → 409.
CANCELLED_PENDING_END → ACTIVE while the period runs; otherwise 409.

get.description: Append-only entries, newest first: SUB_REVENUE / PLATFORM_FEE of each payment (reversed by a void) and PAYOUT debits.

post.description: amount: integer 100000–1000000000 (REQUIRED / MIN / MAX); bankCode one of VCB, TCB, BIDV, VTB, ACB, MB, VPB, TPB, STB, VIB, SHB, HDB (ENUM); accountNumber 6–20 digits (FORMAT); accountName is trimmed, spaces collapsed, upper-cased, 2–100 chars (LENGTH), A–Z and spaces only (FORMAT). 409 INVALID_STATE details.reason: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE (+ available) or PAYOUT_PENDING. Requires Idempotency-Key.

get.description: Gross, platform fee (5%, rounded down) and net over the range (days start at 00:00 in tz), today's net for the dashboard tile, the ledger balance, pending payouts and live subscribers.
Every tier of the caller's channel, inactive ones included, with live subscriber counts. No channel → 403 NOT_CREATOR.

patch.description: Prices are fixed. Tier 1 cannot be turned off (active = INVALID); description ≤ 200 characters after trim; an empty body → body = REQUIRED.
patch.summary: Turn a tier on / off or edit its description

post.description: Called by SePay with X-Secret-Key. 200 {"success":true} when applied, a duplicate, ignored, not approved, an unknown invoice or an amount mismatch (the order becomes FAILED AMOUNT_MISMATCH); 401 wrong secret; 400 malformed or over 64 KB; 500 temporary error (SePay retries).

reason.example: Account name does not match the channel owner
